displayName: Sweet Corn American Dream F1 Seed
notes: Bicolor SE type; 7.5" trim ears, 16-18 rows; 6' plants, ears at 26"; intermediate resistance to NCLB. Isolation required. Raw/untreated.
harvestIndicators: Husk still green, silks dry and brown, kernels full size to the tip of the ear
Milky stage: a punctured kernel gives milky juice (clear = immature, none = too late)
About 17 to 24 days after first silks appear
